alternatives.reason: SDK inode and compiler bytes do not represent every build dependency; no complete input manifest exists.
The retained qualified identical image bytes at fresh paths/inodes do not establish a causal improvement.
Changes current source/path admission, path-filtered collectors and delayed/concurrent policy attribution; first test whether private-path hard links preserve the existing contract.

candidate.cleanup: Private mode retirement removes its own link after existing cleanup; retained immutable store lifetime needs separately owned maintenance.
candidate.compile: Keep current selected compiler, source, arguments, environment and bounds on every preparation.
candidate.failure: Compile, collision, identity, capacity, hard-link or admission failures remain failures. No first-run prewarming, automatic retry, deadline extension or copying fallback.
candidate.identity: Use generated C bytes and actual completed executable bytes; compare bytes through checked descriptors before reuse. A changed output selects a distinct image.
candidate.materialization: Prefer a same-volume hard link at the existing per-mode rust-tools/rustup path if native path and source-custody behavior qualify.
candidate.name: compile_then_reuse_identical_image
candidate.not_claimed: No cache hit, policy-scan avoidance, performance gain, complete build-input attestation or historical startup repair is established.
candidate.publication: A fixed repository-local private store may retain immutable image inodes, with exclusive publication and bounded capacity; do not overwrite or evict live identities.

established_constraints: The builder compiles each generated mode in one private workspace and seals its descriptor before returning.
The resolver canonicalizes Cargo and chooses its rustup branch by the resulting basename; installed-utility symlinks were already rejected.
The sampler requires the exact private workspace rustup executable path and archives binary/C/wrapper identities before and after inspection.
Mode retirement removes only its private workspace after every admitted compiler/runtime owner reports cleanup.
The current compiler/SDK snapshot is not a complete compiler/linker dependency manifest.
The recorded native output hashes repeat across qualified preparations, but fresh paths still receive policy scans.

next_experiment.admission: Qualify source/binary/argv/deadline/native-birth/collector bounds and exact invocation count before any execution. A held purpose-built path-control may be needed to observe fast exec; it is not an original fixture qualification.
counterexamples: link retirement changing surviving image bytes
next_experiment.first_use: Retain cold and reuse outcomes separately. Stop at first unexpected failure; a later pass must never replace it. No original test is selected.
